subject: Reminder about Friday call
text: As your old classmate, I would like to confirm whether the client call on Friday still stands. I want to prepare the budget summary in advance, and I do not want to duplicate last week’s confusion. My train was cancelled overnight because of signal work, so I may not reach the office as soon as planned. If the meeting proceeds, I can join remotely, though the connection is not always stable. I would be grateful for confirmation by early tomorrow, especially if there are changes to the agenda. If the call moves to next week, I can update the shared tracker and ask the others to review their sections beforehand. With thanks
